d:
With his and-one FT at 6:30 3Q, Paul George (31+ PTS) passed Kristaps Porzingis in 2023 (30 PTS) for the most points in a Celtics debut. With 38 points and 5 steals vs. DET, Paul George became the first player (since individual steals started being tracked in 1973-74) to record 35+ PTS and 5+ STL in a debut with a new team.
